Two points remain unassessed: whether the ABG ownership sentence in the conformance document uses current terms (req-pressure:12), and what executeFromPlan: false means (req-pressure:15). The mapping of observed results to executionStatus, planSatisfied, pass count and the stdout digest is still undecided (req-pressure:04).
